units.id: phrase:remnant uncontacted|"If you value the continued survival of humanity, do not scan our ships," a strangely melodic voice says.|367|0
units.english: "If you value the continued survival of humanity, do not scan our ships," a strangely melodic voice says.
units.italian: "Se tieni alla sopravvivenza dell'umanità, non scansionare le nostre navi", dice una voce stranamente melodiosa.

units.id: phrase:remnant uncontacted|"If you value your continued survival, do not scan our ships." The voice speaks with a tone reminiscent of singing.|368|0
units.english: "If you value your continued survival, do not scan our ships." The voice speaks with a tone reminiscent of singing.
units.italian: "Se tieni alla tua sopravvivenza, non scansionare le nostre navi." La voce parla con un tono che ricorda il canto.

units.id: phrase:remnant uncontacted|"We value our privacy, and will respond to scanning with deadly force." The voice is strangely melodic.|369|0
units.english: "We value our privacy, and will respond to scanning with deadly force." The voice is strangely melodic.
units.italian: "Teniamo alla nostra riservatezza e risponderemo alle scansioni con la forza letale." La voce è stranamente melodiosa.

units.id: phrase:remnant uncontacted|"Do not scan our ships," someone sings to you.|370|0
units.english: "Do not scan our ships," someone sings to you.
units.italian: "Non scansionare le nostre navi", ti canta qualcuno.
